title: MORE(theme from Mondo Cane)--Andy Williams
lyrics_plain:
More than the greatest love
the world has known
this is the love I give
to you alone
More than the kindest words
I try to say
I only live to love you
more each day
More than you'll ever know
my arms long to hold you so
my life will be in your keeping
always waiting, never weeping
Longer than always is a long, long time
But far beyond forever you'll be mine
I know I've never lived before
and my heart is very sure
No one else can love you more
More than you'll ever know
my arms long to hold you so
My life will be in your keeping
always waiting, never weeping
Longer than always is a long long time
but far beyond forever you'll be mine
I know I've never loved before
and my heart is very sure
No one else can love you more
